Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/markdown', uri: 'https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md'), { 'chunking' => { 'chunker_type' => 'markdown', 'max_chars' => 500, 'max_overlap' => 50, 'trim' => true } })
puts result.results[0].chunks.inspect
```
